take_homes: Run one agent per recurring workflow, and split only for different access, dialect or stance. Don't split to look thorough.
Give the synthesizer a framework like Rumelt's kernel so it commits to one diagnosis. Otherwise you get a beige average.
Failures happen at the handoffs between agents. When something breaks, find out whether the fault is in the sources, the processing or the boundary, then write the lesson into CLAUDE.md.
